description: MCP server for Russian construction market data. Access 3,395 construction companies, 13,436 projects across 18 regions of Russia. Search contractors, compare prices, analyze ratings, get market reports — all via MCP protocol. 21 tools including search, analytics, cost estimation, contractor recommendations, and request-for-quote lead generation. Real data from 2GIS and company websites. SEO-friendly company pages and full sitemap with 3,400+ URLs.
